description: This PHP class 'ViewEmailConfigurationController' extends AbstractVueController and manages the email configuration view in the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It retrieves the 'sendmail' path from configuration and passes it to a Vue component for rendering.

classes.name: ViewEmailConfigurationController
classes.description: Controller responsible for preparing the email configuration view in the admin plugin, fetching configuration data, and passing it to a Vue component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data for rendering the email configuration Vue component by retrieving the sendmail path and setting up the component with the necessary properties.
